title: [Project Chromata] Mixer/siphon/star hit boxes are very frustrating
summary: ### Game Project Chromata ### Report type bug ### Description The text below a mixer is included in its hitbox, and shouldn’t be. You normally want compact layouts, so this ends up meaning you have to click on the row below to get a mixer, and often can’t select a siphon or star without moving things. Actually, I’m not sold on the text below mixers. Perhaps it’d be better inside the circle. Submitted through the account-free feedback form. No private reply address was collected.

title: [balance] Only Spätzle-IX scenario seems impossible/tedious
summary: ### What feels off? Without connecting to any tier 1 networks, you can't get enough reach so that customers stay. The only way I can see to win this scenario would be to get enough L2VPN customers to make enough money to do a "big bang" set of broadband launches that get you the traffic requirement even though the customers would be unhappy with the reach. ### How it is in real life Primarily this is a game balance issue. But a network that only allows you to talk to certain services could make sense. ### What would you change? (optional) Maybe you could have a cheap service offering where customers wouldn't get so unhappy with lower reach to make it possible? ### Game version 1.28.0 ### Before you submit - [x] I searched the existing issues and this is not already reported. - [x] This issue is about one topic only.
